answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops sybil attacks: each identity earns standing on its own voyage. A newcomer starts with basic permissions; its behavior is recorded as a fingerprint in escrow, and higher stages unlock only when new behavior matches it. A gale of copies cannot fake this: with no history to mirror, each must repeat the voyage. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 voyages of real work, 20 epochs each; one honest agent pays once.
